# Renewable Energy Cost Revolution: LCOE, Capacity & Fossil Fuel Subsidies (2010–2024)

## Overview
This collection of four datasets tracks the economic transformation of the global energy sector from 2010 to 2024. It covers the declining levelized cost of energy for solar PV, onshore wind, and battery storage; the cost range of new fossil fuel generation; cumulative renewable installed capacity; and annual global fossil fuel subsidies.

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch

# --- Data ---
years = list(range(2010, 2025))
solar_lcoe = [359,304,223,175,136,107,86,72,60,50,42,39,45,37,33]
wind_lcoe = [95,89,82,78,72,64,56,52,48,44,41,38,42,37,35]
battery_lcoe = [1100,980,860,750,620,510,395,310,245,187,150,132,139,119,102]

ff_years = [2010,2012,2014,2016,2018,2020,2022,2024]
gas_low = [55,50,48,42,44,45,55,50]
gas_high = [82,78,75,72,78,74,95,80]
coal_low = [65,63,60,60,62,65,75,70]
coal_high = [105,100,98,95,100,110,130,120]

solar_cap = [40,70,100,137,177,227,303,402,512,627,760,942,1185,1550,1950]
wind_cap = [178,215,260,296,336,380,425,480,540,594,650,725,800,880,960]

subsidy_total = [410,500,530,510,490,325,310,340,400,380,290,440,700,620,550]

# --- Colors ---
COL_SOLAR = '#E8871E'
COL_WIND = '#2D8BC9'
COL_BATTERY = '#8B5CF6'
COL_FOSSIL_BAND = '#D4D4D4'
COL_SUBSIDY = '#DC2626'
COL_SOLAR_CAP = '#F59E0B'
COL_WIND_CAP = '#3B82F6'
BG = '#FAFAFA'
TEXT = '#1A1A1A'
GRID = '#E5E5E5'

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 20), facecolor=BG)
fig.subplots_adjust(hspace=0.35, top=0.93, bottom=0.04, left=0.08, right=0.92)

fig.text(0.5, 0.965, 'The Renewable Energy Cost Revolution', ha='center', va='bottom',
         fontsize=26, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT, fontfamily='sans-serif')
fig.text(0.5, 0.955, 'LCOE, Installed Capacity & Fossil Fuel Subsidies, 2010\u20132024',
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=14, color='#666666', fontfamily='sans-serif')

# ============ PANEL 1: LCOE with fossil band ============
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(3, 1, 1)
ax1.set_facecolor(BG)

# Fossil fuel cost band (interpolate to all years)
ff_gas_low_interp = np.interp(years, ff_years, gas_low)
ff_gas_high_interp = np.interp(years, ff_years, gas_high)
ff_coal_low_interp = np.interp(years, ff_years, coal_low)
ff_coal_high_interp = np.interp(years, ff_years, coal_high)
ff_overall_low = np.minimum(ff_gas_low_interp, ff_coal_low_interp)
ff_overall_high = np.maximum(ff_gas_high_interp, ff_coal_high_interp)

ax1.fill_between(years, ff_overall_low, ff_overall_high, color=COL_FOSSIL_BAND, alpha=0.6,
                  label='New fossil fuel LCOE range', zorder=1)
ax1.plot(years, ff_overall_low, color='#AAAAAA', lw=0.8, zorder=1)
ax1.plot(years, ff_overall_high, color='#AAAAAA', lw=0.8, zorder=1)

ax1.plot(years, solar_lcoe, color=COL_SOLAR, lw=2.8, marker='o', ms=5, zorder=3, label='Solar PV')
ax1.plot(years, wind_lcoe, color=COL_WIND, lw=2.8, marker='s', ms=5, zorder=3, label='Onshore Wind')
ax1.plot(years, battery_lcoe, color=COL_BATTERY, lw=2.8, marker='^', ms=5, zorder=3, label='Battery Storage')

# Crossover annotations
# Solar crosses below fossil high (~105) around 2014 ($136>105), below fossil low (~60) around 2018 ($60)
# Wind crosses below fossil high around 2010 already (95<105), below fossil low around 2020 ($41<~50)
# Solar below gas_high: 2016 (86 < ~72+high interp). Let's find exact crossovers.
# Solar < fossil_overall_high: between 2014(136) and 2015(107) vs high ~97. So ~2015.

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 22), facecolor=BG)

# --- Main title ---
fig.text(0.50, 0.975, 'The Renewable Energy Cost Revolution',
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=24, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT, fontfamily='serif')
fig.text(0.50, 0.950, 'LCOE, Installed Capacity & Fossil Fuel Subsidies | 2010\u20132024',
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=13, color=SUBTLE, fontfamily='sans-serif')

def style_ax(ax):
    ax.set_facecolor(BG)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['left'].set_color(GRID)
    ax.spines['bottom'].set_color(GRID)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT, labelsize=10)
    ax.grid(axis='y', color=GRID, lw=0.6, zorder=0)

# ============ PANEL 1: LCOE with fossil band ============
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
style_ax(ax1)

ff_overall_low = np.interp(years, ff_years, [min(gl, cl) for gl, cl in zip(gas_low, coal_low)])
ff_overall_high = np.interp(years, ff_years, [max(gh, ch) for gh, ch in zip(gas_high, coal_high)])

ax1.fill_between(years, ff_overall_low, ff_overall_high, color=COL_FOSSIL_BAND, alpha=0.55,
                  label='New fossil fuel LCOE range', zorder=1, edgecolor='#B0B0B0', lw=0.5)

ax1.plot(years, battery_lcoe, color=COL_BATTERY, lw=2.6, marker='^', ms=5.5, zorder=3,

ax1.plot(years, solar_lcoe, color=COL_SOLAR, lw=2.6, marker='o', ms=5.5, zorder=3,

         label='Onshore Wind', markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.5)

ax1.annotate('Solar enters fossil\ncost range (2016)',
             xy=(2016, 86), xytext=(2012.2, 40),
             fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=COL_SOLAR,

             ha='center', zorder=5, bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc=BG, ec=COL_SOLAR, alpha=0.9, lw=0.8))

ax1.annotate('Wind below cheapest\nfossil option (2020)',

             ha='center', zorder=5, bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc=BG, ec=COL_WIND, alpha=0.9, lw=0.8))

# Battery cost collapse
ax1.annotate('Battery storage:\n$1,100 \u2192 $102/MWh (\u221291%)',
             xy=(2011, 980), xytext=(2016, 850),
             fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=COL_BATTERY,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COL_BATTERY, lw=1.4, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.15'),
             ha='center', zorder=5, bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc=BG, ec=COL_BATTERY, alpha=0.9, lw=0.8))

# Solar % drop label
ax1.text(2024.3, 33, '$33', fontsize=8.5, color=COL_SOLAR, fontweight='bold', va='center')
ax1.text(2024.3, 102, '$102', fontsize=8.5, color=COL_BATTERY, fontweight='bold', va='center')

ax1.set_ylabel('LCOE (USD/MWh, 2023 real)', fontsize=11, color=TEXT, labelpad=8)
ax1.set_title('Levelized Cost of Energy: Renewables vs. New Fossil Fuel Generation',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT, pad=10, loc='left')
ax1.set_xlim(2009.5, 2025.2)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1180)
ax1.set_xticks(years)
ax1.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9.5, framealpha=0.95, edgecolor=GRID, fancybox=False)

# ============ PANEL 2: Installed Capacity ============
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
style_ax(ax2)

ax2.fill_between(years, solar_cap, alpha=0.12, color=COL_SOLAR_CAP, zorder=1)
ax2.fill_between(years, wind_cap, alpha=0.12, color=COL_WIND_CAP, zorder=1)

# Acceleration marker
ax2.axvline(2018, color=SUBTLE, ls=':', lw=1, alpha=0.6, zorder=2)
ax2.annotate('Steep acceleration\npost-2018', xy=(2018.2, 1550), fontsize=9.5,
             fontweight='bold', color='#B45309', ha='left', zorder=5,
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc=BG, ec='#B45309', alpha=0.85, lw=0.8))

# End labels
ax2.text(2024.3, 1950, '1,950 GW', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color=COL_SOLAR_CAP, va='center')

ax2.set_xlim(2009.5, 2025.8)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 2200)
ax2.set_xticks(years)
ax2.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f'{x:,.0f}'))
ax2.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9.5, framealpha=0.95, edgecolor=GRID, fancybox=False)

ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
style_ax(ax3)

bars = ax3.bar(years, subsidy_total, color=COL_SUBSIDY, alpha=0.65, width=0.65, zorder=2,

ax3b = ax3.twinx()
solar_idx = [s/solar_lcoe[0]*100 for s in solar_lcoe]
wind_idx = [w/wind_lcoe[0]*100 for w in wind_lcoe]
battery_idx = [b/battery_lcoe[0]*100 for b in battery_lcoe]

ax3b.plot(years, solar_idx, color=COL_SOLAR, lw=2.5, marker='o', ms=4, zorder=3,
          label='Solar PV LCOE index', markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.4)
ax3b.plot(years, wind_idx, color=COL_WIND, lw=2.5, marker='s', ms=4, zorder=3,
          label='Onshore Wind LCOE index', markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.4)
ax3b.plot(years, battery_idx, color=COL_BATTERY, lw=2.5, marker='^', ms=4, zorder=3,
          label='Battery LCOE index', markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.4)

ax3b.set_ylabel('LCOE Index (2010 = 100)', fontsize=11, color=TEXT, labelpad=8)

ax3b.spines['right'].set_color(GRID)
ax3b.spines['bottom'].set_color(GRID)

# Divergence annotation
ax3.annotate('Subsidies surged to $700B\nduring 2022 energy crisis',

             fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=COL_SUBSIDY,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COL_SUBSIDY, lw=1.4),
             ha='center', zorder=5,
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc=BG, ec=COL_SUBSIDY, alpha=0.9, lw=0.8))

# Show divergence narrative
ax3.annotate('Renewable costs fell 63\u201391%\nwhile subsidies persisted at\n$290\u2013700B annually',
             xy=(2020, 290), xytext=(2012, 780),
             fontsize=9, color=SUBTLE, fontstyle='italic',
             ha='center', zorder=5,
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', fc='#FFF7ED', ec=SUBTLE, alpha=0.85, lw=0.6))

ax3.set_ylabel('Annual Fossil Fuel Subsidies (Billion USD)', fontsize=11, color=TEXT, labelpad=8)
ax3.set_title('Persistent Fossil Fuel Subsidies vs. Collapsing Renewable Costs',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT, pad=10, loc='left')
ax3.set_xlim(2009.5, 2024.5)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 900)
ax3.set_xticks(years)

lines3a, labels3a = ax3.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines3b, labels3b = ax3b.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax3.legend(lines3a + lines3b, labels3a + labels3b, loc='center right', fontsize=9,
           framealpha=0.95, edgecolor=GRID, fancybox=False)

# Source footnote
fig.text(0.50, 0.010,
         'Data: Illustrative estimates aligned with IRENA & BloombergNEF reporting trends  |  LCOE in 2023 real USD/MWh  |  Subsidies in nominal USD  |  2024 values are preliminary',
         ha='center', fontsize=8.5, color=SUBTLE, fontfamily='sans-serif')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, facecolor=BG, bbox_inches='tight')
